_comment: Shape of a real PubChem PUG-REST fastsimilarity_2d/cid/<CID>/cids/JSON response. Recorded shape, hand-built contents: the CIDs are real PubChem compound identifiers for well-known small molecules, chosen so the offline selftest exercises every filter. Nothing here is fetched at test time; tools/harvest.mjs --selftest runs with fetch disabled.
